content.title: Major retailers adjust hours for Easter Sunday 2026
content.text: Kroger confirms Easter Sunday 2026 store hours Kroger has confirmed that most of its grocery stores will operate during regular business hours on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, typically from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. or 7 a.m. to 11 p.m., depending on location. A spokesperson advised customers to call ahead to confirm local hours. Kroger joins other open chains such as Walmart, Trader Joe’s, Meijer, Winn-Dixie, and Whole Foods in serving last‑minute holiday shoppers. Men's Journal Why this matters for holiday shoppers Easter Sunday is not a federal holiday, yet many retailers close or reduce hours to allow employees time with family. This means consumers may face limited shopping options and heavier crowds at stores that remain open. Planning ahead can help avoid stock shortages and long lines, particularly for holiday meal essentials and seasonal items. Newsweek How other major retailers are operating on Easter 2026 Several major chains, including Target, Costco, Aldi, Publix, Sam’s Club, and Lowe’s, will be closed nationwide on Easter Sunday. Open retailers include Walmart, CVS, Dollar General, and many fast‑food outlets such as McDonald’s, Dunkin’, and Starbucks, though hours may vary. Some malls and department stores will also close entirely, while others may open select locations with modified schedules. Newsweek + 2 What shoppers should do next Consumers are encouraged to check individual store hours online or by phone before heading out, as schedules can vary by location. Those relying on closed retailers should complete shopping by Saturday evening to avoid last‑minute disruptions. With open stores likely to experience increased traffic, arriving early could help secure needed items before stock runs low. AL.com + 1 4 references
